title: First jazz bands heard across the lake
summary: Bands heard around Covington and Bogalusa, mostly Black, including Buddy Petit, Sam Morgan, Claiborne Williams and Blanchard's band with Snoozer Quinn.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: What was the first band you remember hearing that played any jazz by name?

Well, that's rather difficult. When you say by name, I guess I would have to go to the bands I heard across the lake, which would have been bands such as Buddy Petit, Sam Morgan, Claiborne Williams, bands of that nature.
Are they all colored bands over there?

Well, just about all. I would say 95% of the bands that played for the dancers around Covington and Bogalusa and that section, where I spent my summers in those days, were colored bands. I recall, however, one white band, which was a band from Bogalusa, called Blanchard's Jazz Band. And the only musician I recall, and the only musician I recall in the band was Snoozer Quinn. I suppose I remember him more than the others because of his deformity. Anyone that ever saw Snoozer would never forget him. And I imagine that would date back to just around 19... 19, 1920. I've heard bands, jazz bands, before that, but don't recall the names or anyone connected with them.
